audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Leviticus / Vayiqra land-Sabbath and Jubilee text tradition, draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for land Sabbath, seven sabbatical cycles, Jubilee trumpet, return of property and kinship, price by harvest years, Divine provision, land redemption, houses, Levite property, poverty support, interest prohibition, Israelite debt-servitude, foreign-owned Israelite redemption, and anti-slavery safeguards.

verses.restored: YHWH spoke to Moses on Mount Sinai, saying,

familiar.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses in mount Sinai, saying,

verses.restored: Speak to children of Israel and say to them: When you come into land that I give you, the land shall keep Sabbath to YHWH.

familiar.text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land which I give you, then shall the land keep a sabbath unto the LORD.

verses.restored: Six years you shall sow your field, and six years prune your vineyard and gather its produce.

familiar.text: Six years thou shalt sow thy field, and six years thou shalt prune thy vineyard, and gather in the fruit thereof;

verses.restored: But in seventh year there shall be Sabbath of Sabbath-rest for land, Sabbath to YHWH; your field you shall not sow and your vineyard you shall not prune.

familiar.text: But in the seventh year shall be a sabbath of rest unto the land, a sabbath for the LORD: thou shalt neither sow thy field, nor prune thy vineyard.

verses.restored: What grows by itself from your harvest you shall not reap, and grapes of your untrimmed vine you shall not gather; year of Sabbath-rest it shall be for land.

familiar.text: That which groweth of its own accord of thy harvest thou shalt not reap, neither gather the grapes of thy vine undressed: for it is a year of rest unto the land.

verses.restored: Sabbath produce of land shall be food for you, for your male servant and female servant, for your hired worker and for sojourner who sojourns with you,

familiar.text: And the sabbath of the land shall be meat for you; for thee, and for thy servant, and for thy maid, and for thy hired servant, and for thy stranger that sojourneth with thee,

verses.restored: and for your beast and wild animal in your land all its produce shall be for food.

familiar.text: And for thy cattle, and for the beast that are in thy land, shall all the increase thereof be meat.

verses.restored: You shall count for yourself seven Sabbaths of years, seven years seven times; days of seven Sabbaths of years shall be for you forty-nine years.

familiar.text: And thou shalt number seven sabbaths of years unto thee, seven times seven years; and the space of the seven sabbaths of years shall be unto thee forty and nine years.

verses.restored: You shall cause trumpet of loud blast to pass in seventh month on tenth of month; on Day of Atonement/Coverings you shall cause trumpet to pass through all your land.

familiar.text: Then shalt thou cause the trumpet of the jubile to sound on the tenth day of the seventh month, in the day of atonement shall ye make the trumpet sound throughout all your land.

verses.restored: You shall sanctify fiftieth year and proclaim liberty/release in land to all its inhabitants; Jubilee it shall be for you, and you shall return each one to his property and each one to his clan shall return.

familiar.text: And ye shall hallow the fiftieth year, and proclaim liberty throughout all the land unto all the inhabitants thereof: it shall be a jubile unto you; and ye shall return every man unto his possession, and ye shall return every man unto his family.

verses.restored: Jubilee, the fiftieth year, it shall be for you; you shall not sow and shall not reap what grows by itself, and shall not gather from untrimmed vines.

familiar.text: A jubile shall that fiftieth year be unto you: ye shall not sow, neither reap that which groweth of itself in it, nor gather the grapes in it of thy vine undressed.

verses.restored: For Jubilee it is; holy it shall be to you. From field you shall eat its produce.

familiar.text: For it is the jubile; it shall be holy unto you: ye shall eat the increase thereof out of the field.

verses.restored: In this year of Jubilee each one shall return to his property.

familiar.text: In the year of this jubile ye shall return every man unto his possession.

verses.restored: When you sell anything to your companion or buy from hand of your companion, do not wrong one another.

familiar.text: And if thou sell ought unto thy neighbour, or buyest ought of thy neighbour’s hand, ye shall not oppress one another:

verses.restored: According to number of years after Jubilee you shall buy from your companion; according to number of crop years he shall sell to you.

familiar.text: According to the number of years after the jubile thou shalt buy of thy neighbour, and according unto the number of years of the fruits he shall sell unto thee:

verses.restored: According to many years you shall increase its price, and according to few years you shall diminish its price, for number of crops he is selling to you.

familiar.text: According to the multitude of years thou shalt increase the price thereof, and according to the fewness of years thou shalt diminish the price of it: for according to the number of the years of the fruits doth he sell unto thee.

verses.restored: You shall not wrong one another, but fear your Divine; for I am YHWH your Divine.

familiar.text: Ye shall not therefore oppress one another; but thou shalt fear thy God:for I am the LORD your God.

verses.restored: You shall do my statutes and keep my judgments and do them, and you shall dwell on land securely.

familiar.text: Wherefore ye shall do my statutes, and keep my judgments, and do them; and ye shall dwell in the land in safety.

verses.restored: The land shall give its fruit, and you shall eat to satisfaction and dwell securely upon it.

familiar.text: And the land shall yield her fruit, and ye shall eat your fill, and dwell therein in safety.

verses.restored: If you say, What shall we eat in seventh year? Look, we shall not sow and shall not gather our produce.

familiar.text: And if ye shall say, What shall we eat the seventh year? behold, we shall not sow, nor gather in our increase:

verses.restored: I will command my blessing for you in sixth year, and it shall make produce for three years.

familiar.text: Then I will command my blessing upon you in the sixth year, and it shall bring forth fruit for three years.

verses.restored: You shall sow eighth year and eat from old produce until ninth year; until its produce comes, you shall eat old.

familiar.text: And ye shall sow the eighth year, and eat yet of old fruit until the ninth year; until her fruits come in ye shall eat of the old store.

verses.restored: The land shall not be sold permanently, for the land is mine; for sojourners and resident settlers you are with me.

familiar.text: The land shall not be sold for ever: for the land is mine; for ye are strangers and sojourners with me.

verses.restored: In all land of your possession you shall give redemption for land.

familiar.text: And in all the land of your possession ye shall grant a redemption for the land.

verses.restored: When your brother becomes poor and sells from his possession, his nearest redeemer shall come and redeem what his brother sold.

familiar.text: If thy brother be waxen poor, and hath sold away some of his possession, and if any of his kin come to redeem it, then shall he redeem that which his brother sold.

verses.restored: If a man has no redeemer but his hand obtains and finds enough for its redemption,

familiar.text: And if the man have none to redeem it, and himself be able to redeem it;

verses.restored: he shall count years from its sale, return excess to man to whom he sold, and return to his possession.

familiar.text: Then let him count the years of the sale thereof, and restore the overplus unto the man to whom he sold it; that he may return unto his possession.

verses.restored: But if his hand does not find enough to return to him, what he sold shall remain in hand of buyer until year of Jubilee; in Jubilee it shall go out, and he shall return to his possession.

familiar.text: But if he be not able to restore it to him, then that which is sold shall remain in the hand of him that hath bought it until the year of jubile: and in the jubile it shall go out, and he shall return unto his possession.

verses.restored: When a man sells dwelling house in walled city, its redemption shall be until completion of year from its sale; a full year shall be its redemption.

familiar.text: And if a man sell a dwelling house in a walled city, then he may redeem it within a whole year after it is sold; within a full year may he redeem it.

verses.restored: If it is not redeemed by completion of full year, house in city with wall shall stand permanently to buyer throughout generations; it shall not go out in Jubilee.

familiar.text: And if it be not redeemed within the space of a full year, then the house that is in the walled city shall be established for ever to him that bought it throughout his generations: it shall not go out in the jubile.

verses.restored: But houses of villages with no wall around them shall be counted as field of land; redemption shall be for it, and in Jubilee it shall go out.

familiar.text: But the houses of the villages which have no wall round about them shall be counted as the fields of the country: they may be redeemed, and they shall go out in the jubile.

verses.restored: As for cities of Levites, houses of cities of their possession, age-long redemption shall be for Levites.

familiar.text: Notwithstanding the cities of the Levites, and the houses of the cities of their possession, may the Levites redeem at any time.

verses.restored: If one redeems from Levites, sold house in city of his possession shall go out in Jubilee, for houses of cities of Levites are their possession among children of Israel.

familiar.text: And if a man purchase of the Levites, then the house that was sold, and the city of his possession, shall go out in the year of jubile: for the houses of the cities of the Levites are their possession among the children of Israel.

verses.restored: Field of pastureland of their cities shall not be sold, for age-long possession it is for them.

familiar.text: But the field of the suburbs of their cities may not be sold; for it is their perpetual possession.

verses.restored: When your brother becomes poor and his hand falters with you, you shall strengthen him, as sojourner and resident settler, and he shall live with you.

familiar.text: And if thy brother be waxen poor, and fallen in decay with thee; then thou shalt relieve him: yea, though he be a stranger, or a sojourner; that he may live with thee.

verses.restored: Do not take from him interest or increase, but fear your Divine, so your brother may live with you.

familiar.text: Take thou no usury of him, or increase: but fear thy God; that thy brother may live with thee.

verses.restored: Your silver you shall not give him at interest, and for increase you shall not give your food.

familiar.text: Thou shalt not give him thy money upon usury, nor lend him thy victuals for increase.

verses.restored: I am YHWH your Divine, who brought you out from land of Egypt, to give you land of Canaan, to be to you as Divine.

familiar.text: I am the LORD your God, which brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, to give you the land of Canaan, and to be your God.

verses.restored: When your brother becomes poor with you and sells himself to you, you shall not make him serve service of slave.

familiar.text: And if thy brother that dwelleth by thee be waxen poor, and be sold unto thee; thou shalt not compel him to serve as a bondservant:

verses.restored: As hired worker, as resident settler, he shall be with you; until year of Jubilee he shall serve with you.

familiar.text: But as an hired servant, and as a sojourner, he shall be with thee, and shall serve thee unto the year of jubile:

verses.restored: Then he shall go out from you, he and his children with him, and return to his clan and to possession of his fathers he shall return.

familiar.text: And then shall he depart from thee, both he and his children with him, and shall return unto his own family, and unto the possession of his fathers shall he return.

verses.restored: For they are my servants whom I brought out from land of Egypt; they shall not be sold as sale of slaves.

familiar.text: For they are my servants, which I brought forth out of the land of Egypt: they shall not be sold as bondmen.

verses.restored: You shall not rule over him with crushing severity, but fear your Divine.

familiar.text: Thou shalt not rule over him with rigour; but shalt fear thy God.

verses.restored: Your male and female slaves whom you may have shall be from nations around you; from them you may acquire male and female slaves.

familiar.text: Both thy bondmen, and thy bondmaids, which thou shalt have, shall be of the heathen that are round about you; of them shall ye buy bondmen and bondmaids.

verses.restored: Also from children of resident settlers sojourning with you, from them you may acquire, and from their clans with you whom they fathered in your land; they may be possession for you.

familiar.text: Moreover of the children of the strangers that do sojourn among you, of them shall ye buy, and of their families that are with you, which they begat in your land: and they shall be your possession.

verses.restored: You may cause them to inherit to your children after you to possess as possession; into the age you may make them serve. But over your brothers, children of Israel, one over another, you shall not rule with crushing severity.

familiar.text: And ye shall take them as an inheritance for your children after you, to inherit them for a possession; they shall be your bondmen for ever: but over your brethren the children of Israel, ye shall not rule one over another with rigour.

verses.restored: When hand of sojourner or resident settler with you obtains wealth, and your brother with him becomes poor and sells himself to sojourner, resident settler with you, or to offspring of clan of sojourner,

familiar.text: And if a sojourner or stranger wax rich by thee, and thy brother that dwelleth by him wax poor, and sell himself unto the stranger or sojourner by thee, or to the stock of the stranger’s family:

verses.restored: after he is sold, redemption shall be for him; one of his brothers may redeem him,

familiar.text: After that he is sold he may be redeemed again; one of his brethren may redeem him:

verses.restored: or his uncle or son of his uncle may redeem him, or from close flesh of his clan may redeem him; or if his hand obtains, he may redeem himself.

familiar.text: Either his uncle, or his uncle’s son, may redeem him, or any that is nigh of kin unto him of his family may redeem him; or if he be able, he may redeem himself.

verses.restored: He shall calculate with his buyer from year he sold himself to him until year of Jubilee, and silver of his sale shall be according to number of years; as days of hired worker shall he be with him.

familiar.text: And he shall reckon with him that bought him from the year that he was sold to him unto the year of jubile: and the price of his sale shall be according unto the number of years, according to the time of an hired servant shall it be with him.

verses.restored: If there are still many years, according to them he shall return his redemption from silver of his purchase.

familiar.text: If there be yet many years behind, according unto them he shall give again the price of his redemption out of the money that he was bought for.

verses.restored: If few years remain until year of Jubilee, he shall calculate for himself; according to his years he shall return his redemption.

familiar.text: And if there remain but few years unto the year of jubile, then he shall count with him, and according unto his years shall he give him again the price of his redemption.

verses.restored: As hired worker year by year he shall be with him; he shall not rule over him with crushing severity before your eyes.

familiar.text: And as a yearly hired servant shall he be with him: and the other shall not rule with rigour over him in thy sight.

verses.restored: If he is not redeemed by these, he shall go out in year of Jubilee, he and his children with him.

familiar.text: And if he be not redeemed in these years, then he shall go out in the year of jubile, both he, and his children with him.

verses.restored: For to me children of Israel are servants; my servants they are whom I brought out from land of Egypt. I am YHWH your Divine.

familiar.text: For unto me the children of Israel are servants; they are my servants whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt: I am the LORD your God.

translation_notes: Jubilee proclaims deror/liberty-release to all inhabitants and resets land and kinship displacement.
Land cannot be sold permanently because land belongs to YHWH; humans are sojourners/resident settlers with Divine.
Sale price is tied to remaining harvest years, limiting speculative permanent ownership.
When a kinsperson becomes poor, the command is strengthen him so he may live with you; interest and food-profit are prohibited.
Israelite debt-servitude is explicitly not to be treated as slave labor and must end by Jubilee.
Verses 44-46 preserve foreign slavery in the ancient source and require the strongest anti-slavery audit; they must not be normalized, defended, or treated as timeless ethics.
Exodus liberation is the chapter's governing moral claim: people liberated from Egypt belong to YHWH, not to human masters.
safety_note: Leviticus 25 must not be used to defend slavery, racial hierarchy, landlord domination, predatory lending, permanent dispossession, or debt bondage. Its strongest trajectory is land rest, return, redemption, release, anti-interest protection, and refusal of crushing rule. The foreign-slavery exception is source-preserved as a morally dangerous ancient limitation requiring explicit rejection in modern application.
